spans.s: वेट् a term applied to roots which optionally admit the application of the augment इ (इट्) to the Ardha- dhatuka affixes placed after them, e. g. roots having got the indica- tory vowel ऊ added to them as also the roots स्वृ, सू, धू and the roots headed by रध् as also some specifically mentioned roots under certain conditions; cf P.
